text:
maria.sales: Hey team – AcmeHealth POC just asked for a compact compliance bundle so they can finish procurement. They want: SOC2 excerpts, ISO scope statement, pen-test letter, network diagram, and KMS separation notes. Also asking whether Dedicated + KMS change the price. Can we scope what we can share + lead times?
kevin.security: @maria.sales ok. Quick list of what we usually provide for POCs: 
- SOC2 Type II: control matrix excerpt (redacted)
- ISO27001: scope statement + certificate excerpt if available
- Pen-test: vendor-signed attestation / letter of pen test (not the report)
- Network diagram: redacted env diagram + CIDR ranges for staging
- KMS: key separation architecture + HSM/KMS integration notes
Also need to know if Acme requests on-prem or VPC-hosted test creds — that affects what we can share. ETA: 48h for most items.
jen.devops: can provide presigned upload and ephemeral staging creds for their scanner. If they want host-level access (onprem) that's an ops + legal review. For uploads, use this naming conv: `acme_evidence/<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf` and TTL 7d.
ryan.eng: we can generate a redacted network diagram + crypto config doc. Need 2 business days to make sure no internal IPs leak. We can also supply a short snippet of our `encryption-at-rest.md` showing KMS separation.
maria.sales: Thanks. @kevin.security any blockers on the pen-test letter? Customer expects a signed short attestation (one page) that we completed a pen test in last 12 months or that we accept a scoped external scan.
kevin.security: We don't publish full reports. We can provide either: (A) our standard pen-test attestation letter (signed by security lead) stating scope and that no critical issues were open at time of test, or (B) a vendor-signed letter if we engaged a 3rd-party. Legal needs to sign off on CYA language. Typical turnaround 5–10 business days for signature.
maria.sales: Price question — does KMS separation + Dedicated reserved capacity require an enterprise add-on? Need a short note for procurement + a delta to the quote.
jen.devops: Dedicated + customer-managed KMS integration typically triggers the Enterprise plan (platform fee) and a Dedicated SKU. Ops note: integration + smoke tests add ~3 business days.
kevin.security: ballpark: Enterprise plan + Dedicated, expect ~20% uplift on list for the Dedicated commitment, plus a one-time integration fee for KMS work. I'll confirm exact numbers with revenue ops.
maria.sales: Cool. I'll tentatively add that to the quote and mark it as subject to final Ops/RevOps validation.
legal-bot: pen-test-letter-template.docx uploaded to internal drive: https://redwood.internal/evidence/pen-test-letter-template.docx (uploader: legal-bot).
ryan.eng: starting work on network diagram + redacted config now. Will push to the presigned bucket when ready. ETA ~48h.
jen.devops: I'll create the presigned upload link and share creds in this thread once done (will mask keys).
maria.sales: Great — plan for customer message: "We can assemble a minimal compliance bundle within 72 hours (SOC2 excerpt, ISO scope, redacted network diagram, KMS architecture). Pen-test attestation/signature may take 5–10 business days. Dedicated+KMS will alter pricing (enterprise add-on + integration fee)." I'll let Acme know.
kevin.security: ack, ping me if they ask for verbatim report or raw logs. We'll push back and offer the attestation + controlled POA.
jen.devops: presigned link posted: https://presign.redwood/uploads/acme_evidence/ (expires in 7d) — PM me if anything fails. :thumbsup:
maria.sales: thanks everyone — I'll update the deal doc and follow up with Acme. If we hit legal gating, I'll escalate.
kevin.security: :thumbsup:
